rationale: The agent correctly authenticated the user using full name and zip and identified the relevant delivered laptop variant. However, it executed an order-changing action (exchange_delivered_order_items) without first stating the exact change and obtaining the user's explicit confirmation, which violates the policy. While the exchange details and price difference matched tool results and subsequent information given was plausible, the lack of pre-action confirmation and failure to clarify which laptop among two delivered items before executing the change constitutes a failure under the stated pass criteria.
